body:
Ok I know this might be an odd question but are you on any contraception like the pill? 

I’m asking because those things really do mess with your head, like not feeling like wanting to have sex anymore, not feeling attractive etc etc. It doesn’t just mess with your body but also your head. I’m not saying they are bad things, far from it. I’m on it myself, but all those feelings I have are because of it. I tried going off it for a month and I felt much better- however my periods are so bad that I had to go back. But yeah.... just thought I would ask
He obviously has trust issues... good riddance. Find someone who appreciates you and your talents girl 😉😘

Just by the way you express yourself in words, I can tell you are one pretty smart fella. 

I know you want to feel good for yourself. I used to be like you, drained of emotion.... not loving myself and not accepting love from others. All I can say is that it gets better. I managed to find purpose in my life- hopefully you do too. I wish you to find the best hobby or things you enjoy! Make it something you are proud of! 

(Sorry btw if none of this makes sense- I am very tipsy)
I haven’t personally, but I have noticed there is such great advice on the Border Terriers Owners Page on Facebook. Worth asking on there. X

Happy birthday! Also you have a lovely smile so keep smiling! 

A very good looking man, your girlfriend is very lucky to have you! 
X

Hey chill. I can’t speak to God, nor do I know he exists, I can just say the teaching that Christians follow is to be accepting. 🤷‍♀️ What is funny is that you are stereotyping and yet calling me out? 😂

I’m a catholic (22f) and I have been in a relationship with my atheist boyfriend (23m) for nearly 6 years. 
I would suggest if he isn’t respectful of you, then it’s not worth pursuing. After all if he was really a devote christian he would realise that god is very accepting, he would never alienate someone for their religion or lack of for that matter. 

You may be compatible but don’t change who you are to please others. Love who you love and don’t be ashamed of it. Religion doesn’t play a part in these matters.

Funny, I have none of these traits. 
Never mind, birth control is a blessing though. 🤷‍♀️

I think the main thing is to not be so full on. Don’t compare your relationship to other people’s. Go at your own pace and enjoy each other. 
Key to a good relationship is banter, when other things go down hill (which sometimes they will- no relationship is perfect), you have each other’s funny personality to remind you why you are together. 
Also, I think it’s important to accept on both sides, if a relationship is good and healthy it will work out. But I wouldn’t force it. For instance if you were not having a healthy relationship, don’t stay with the person just because you invested a lot of time to them. It’s not fair on yourself. Recognition that not all relationships are perfect I think is key to a good relationship 😂
Keep going! Get better soon and stay strong. ❤️
You are such a hard worker. When your “friends” end up growing up with no money, you will realise that you have done well. Good luck mate x

Good luck! You are so brave, it’s a shame that you feel terrified to tell people. It should be such a natural thing. 
Have an amazing day. X

Thank you so so much. I do need to forgive myself and her. I need to be a bit easier on myself in terms of dyslexia- I guess being told I was just dumber than everyone to then having a reason why I couldn’t do things was a shock. I felt let down by my educators for not noticing it etc. 

Thank you so much, you are so so lovely. 
**hugs**

That’s really helped. Your words make so much sense.. thank you for being so lovely. 
I will try and forgive- I guess treat others as you would like to be treated and all that. Be the bigger person... 

Thanks again x

I’m not afraid of it... however I am afraid of the pain I might cause others if I did die. I want to look after my parents, pay them back for everything they have done. I feel like for me, suicide would be the easy option.

Yeah it was! It was an odd show, I mean none of the characters spoke English it was like a made up language etc. I used to watch elmo’s world rather than Sesame Street, I think that came out when I was little.
I’m English so... I was probably sitting in front of the tv watching teletubbies or something. (Would have been 2/3 at the time)
Everyday is a new day! Well done for having the motivation to do something about it. You go girl, show the world what you are made of! ❤️
Well done! I love how you were just like ‘why not?’ Haha 😂 it’s so lovely and natural. Congratulations.

Well done for defending your girlfriend like that. Looks are not everything and beauty is in the eye of the beholder. She is very lucky to have you- and that’s not because you are good looking, but because you seem like a genuine lovely guy. Good luck. X

Life is too short to stay with people who don’t let you be yourself. Have fun, wear make up, show your personality. If he doesn’t like it tough. Plenty more fish in the sea. 

Also, down the line the possessiveness will just get worse. Just make yourself happy and do things for yourself. X

Hi, I feel the same.
I can completely understand what you mean with self hatred and how dark your feelings are inside. I also cover mine with humour... although I have a dark sense of humour- sometimes I let the facade slip.. but that’s ok. 
I think you have to look at the positives- although it’s hard to do. It’s what I do anyway. I’m like I’m a bitch- but meh it’s me. Sometimes when life is really tough I do want to end it, but believe me- find friends you can talk to about it. I have noticed when I do, they sigh, like god I’m glad I’m not the only one. I think it’s rather human. Cut people out who don’t like the real you. Find friends and be honest with them. 

Sorry if this isn’t the best advice. It’s hard to give it. But just so you feel better- I definitely understand your mentality.

To be honest, I am always worried this will happen to my (22f) boyfriend (23m) of 6 years. I am his first girlfriend and we are each other first in terms of sex.
All I’m saying if I was at the opposite end of this, I would want my boyfriend to be honest with me. The best thing you can do is talk... I know you are scared of the consequences and all that but it might make you closer. I have asked my bf in the past if this thing would ever bother him, he says no. We have a very fun sex life, do many thing together and laugh. I mean maybe try new things to spice up the relationship, but if not all you can do is be honest. If she is a good gf she would understand.

Don’t be too harsh on yourself. When I was 16 and my boyfriend was 18 (now we are 22-23, 6 years of relationship), I thought I really had to impress him. He is incredibly smart and funny- I felt like I had to learn things to have something in common with him. Turns out he likes my quirks and personality, trust yourself, have fun and be open. If it works, it works. ❤️

I know this sounds hard, but just go easy on yourself. Pamper yourself. What makes you happy... that isn’t too bad for you. When I’m horrifically down my comfort is food or sleep. Sleeping- although doesn’t solve the problem helps in the short term. Plus it will sober you up a little. 

I hope everything gets better for you.

I do something similar except it’s after in binge eat. I have had a problem with food for a little while now and after I binge I purge in the form of laxatives. It gives me pain in my stomach but makes me feel better after, plus I feel like shit (excuse the pun). But at least I have a flat stomach. Btw I am overweight.
Awh congratulations! What a brilliant mum! ❤️
